이.forms: 이 + noun: 이 사람 · 이 책 · 이것 (this thing) · 여기 (here)
이.e: 이/그/저 = this / that (near you) / that over there. Homonyms: 이 also means tooth and two.

이.forms: Sino-Korean · dates, money, minutes, phone numbers, floors (이 층, 이월)
이.x: My room is on the second floor.
이.e: Homonyms: 이 also means 'this' and 'tooth' — context tells you which.
이.t: Don't mix it up with 이 'this' or the subject particle 이 — context makes it clear.

이.ex: 단 음식을 많이 먹어서 이가 아파요.
이.x: I ate a lot of sweets, so my tooth hurts.
이.e: Homonym warning: 이 also means 'this' and 'two'; 치아 is the formal word for tooth.
이.t: In compounds it often becomes 니: 앞니 (front tooth), 어금니 (molar).

해.e: Sun and year: one trip around the sun. 올해 = this year, 새해 = New Year.
해.t: 해 also means 'sun': 해가 떠요 = The sun rises. Count years with native numbers: 한 해, 두 해.

물고기.x: There are lots of fish in the river.
물고기.t: 물고기 is a live fish; fish you eat is usually 생선. Pronounced [물꼬기].

북쪽.x: Seoul is much farther north than Busan.
북쪽.t: The same 북 and 남 give 북한 "North Korea" and 남한 "South Korea."

태권도.ex: 우리 아이는 매일 태권도를 배우러 가요.
태권도.x: My child goes to taekwondo lessons every day.
태권도.e: Literally 'the way of kicking and punching'.

핸드폰.ex: 핸드폰을 집에 두고 와서 연락을 못 했어요.
핸드폰.x: I left my phone at home, so I couldn't contact you.
핸드폰.e: Konglish from English 'hand' + 'phone'; English speakers say 'cell phone'.
핸드폰.t: 휴대폰 and 휴대전화 mean the same; 휴대전화 is the formal word used in news.

바르다.forms: 발라요 · 발랐어요 · 바를 거예요 · 바르세요 (르 irregular)
바르다.m: to apply, to put on, to spread (cream, lotion, butter)
바르다.ex: 밖에 나가기 전에 선크림을 꼭 바르세요.
바르다.x: Be sure to put on sunscreen before you go outside.
바르다.e: Homonym warning: the adjective 바르다 means 'upright, correct'.
바르다.t: Use 바르다 for anything spread on skin or bread: 약을 바르다, 버터를 바르다.

적당하다.m: to be suitable, to be appropriate; to be moderate, just right
적당하다.ex: 운동은 매일 적당히 하는 게 좋아요.
적당하다.x: It's good to exercise moderately every day.
적당하다.e: Literally 'suited and proper' — not too much, not too little.
적당하다.t: 적당히 can also mean 'half-heartedly': 적당히 하지 마세요 = Don't just do it halfway.

예를 들면.forms: 예를 들면 … · 예를 들어(서) · 예를 들자면
예를 들면.ex: 저는 운동을 좋아해요. 예를 들면 수영이나 테니스요.
예를 들면.x: I like sports. For example, swimming or tennis.
예를 들면.e: 예 'example' + 를 + 들다 'to hold up, give' + -면 'if': 'if I give an example'.
예를 들면.t: 예를 들어 is equally common, especially in writing and presentations.

면.x: That person has a kind side.
면.e: Literally 'face'. Homonym warning: 면 also means noodles or cotton.
면.t: Common pattern: -는 면에서 (in terms of), e.g. 가격 면에서 (in terms of price).

정신적.ex: 일이 많아서 요즘 정신적으로 많이 힘들어요.
정신적.x: I've had a lot of work, so I've been struggling mentally lately.

동향.ex: 정부는 국내 경제 동향을 매달 발표합니다.
동향.x: The government announces domestic economic trends every month.

특종.ex: 그 기자는 그 사건을 특종으로 보도했어요.
특종.x: The reporter broke the story as an exclusive.
특종.e: Literally 'special kind' of news that only one outlet has.

소화제.ex: 점심을 너무 많이 먹어서 소화제를 먹었어요.
소화제.x: I ate too much lunch, so I took a digestive aid.
소화제.t: Koreans reach for 소화제 when they 체하다 — that heavy, 'blocked' feeling after eating.

학력.ex: 그 회사는 학력보다 경험을 더 중요하게 생각해요.
학력.x: That company values experience more than educational background.
학력.e: Literally 'study history' — your record of schooling.
학력.t: Pronounced [항녁]; a homonym 학력 means 'academic ability', so context decides.

리모컨.x: I can't find where the remote is.
리모컨.e: From English 'remote control', clipped to 리모컨: Konglish, Americans just say 'remote'.

행정.ex: 이 동네는 행정 서비스가 아주 빨라요.
행정.x: Administrative services in this neighborhood are very fast.

대리인.ex: 본인이 못 오면 대리인이 서류를 받을 수 있어요.
대리인.x: If you can't come yourself, a representative can pick up the documents.
대리인.e: Literally 'a person who manages things in your place'.

자부심.ex: 저는 우리 회사에서 일하는 것에 자부심을 느껴요.
자부심.x: I take pride in working at our company.
자부심.e: Literally 'a heart that carries itself' — standing tall about what you do.

정직.x: I think honesty is the best policy.

때마침.m: just in time, right then, opportunely
때마침.ex: 비가 오기 시작했는데 때마침 버스가 왔어요.
때마침.x: It started raining, and just then the bus came.
때마침.e: 때 'time' + 마침 'just then': 'right at the right time'.

일일이.forms: 일일이 + verb: 일일이 확인하다, 일일이 설명하다
일일이.m: one by one, each and every, in detail
일일이.x: The teacher checked each student's homework one by one.
일일이.e: Literally 'one-one' — going through things one at a time.
일일이.t: Pronounced [이리리] — each ㄹ simply links to the next vowel (no ㄴ insertion).

충족하다.ex: 지원자는 다음 조건을 모두 충족해야 합니다.
충족하다.x: Applicants must meet all of the following conditions.

독자적.x: That company developed its own technology.
독자적.e: Literally 'alone by oneself' — doing it on your own.
독자적.t: Pronounced [독짜적]; common in news: 독자적으로 판단하다 (to judge independently).

라이브 방송.ex: 오늘 밤 아홉 시에 라이브 방송을 할게요.
라이브 방송.x: I'll do a livestream tonight at nine.
라이브 방송.t: Casually shortened to 라방; 라방을 켜다 = to go live.

장작.x: We bought firewood at the campsite and made a fire.
장작.e: Literally 'long chopped (wood)': logs cut into lengths and split.
장작.t: 'Burn firewood' is 장작을 때다, and a wood fire is 장작불.

크리에이터.x: These days many people work as independent creators.
크리에이터.t: Sounds more professional than 유튜버 and covers any platform. 1인 크리에이터 'one-person creator' is someone who plans, films and edits alone.

역사의식.ex: 젊은 세대에게 올바른 역사의식을 심어 주어야 합니다.
역사의식.x: We need to instill proper historical awareness in the younger generation.

정상.m: head of state, leader (at a summit); summit, top
정상.x: The leaders of the two countries met in Seoul.
정상.e: Literally 'the very top', like a mountain summit.
정상.t: Homonym: 정상 (正常) means 'normal', as in 정상 체온 'normal body temperature'.

악성.m: malignancy; malignant, vicious (often used before a noun)
악성.x: The test results showed that it was a malignant tumor.
악성.t: Outside medicine, 악성 means vicious: 악성 댓글 (악플, hate comments), 악성 코드 (malware).

가공식품.ex: 가공식품을 너무 많이 먹으면 건강에 안 좋아요.
가공식품.x: Eating too much processed food is bad for your health.

고소인.ex: 고소인은 경찰서에서 피해 사실을 자세히 진술했습니다.
고소인.x: The complainant described the harm in detail at the police station.
고소인.e: -인 = person in a legal role: 고소인, 피고인, 변호인.
고소인.t: 고소 is filed by the victim; 고발 is filed by a third party who isn't the victim.

재정적자.ex: 올해 재정적자는 사상 최대 규모를 기록했습니다.
재정적자.x: This year's budget deficit hit a record high.
재정적자.e: 적자 is literally 'red figures', from losses written in red ink.
재정적자.t: 적자 = deficit and 흑자 'black letters' = surplus, just like 'in the red / in the black'.

정쟁.x: The public is tired of the endless partisan fighting.

자유권.x: Freedom of expression is a typical civil liberty.
자유권.e: Rights that protect you from the state: speech, religion, movement.

생경하다.ex: 오랜만에 돌아온 고향 풍경이 생경하게 느껴졌어요.
생경하다.x: Back after so long, my hometown scenery felt strangely unfamiliar.
생경하다.e: Literally 'raw and hard' — not yet softened by familiarity.

의뭉스럽다.ex: 그는 모르는 척하지만 사실 꽤 의뭉스러운 사람이에요.
의뭉스럽다.x: He pretends not to know, but he's actually quite a sly person.
의뭉스럽다.e: From 의뭉 'simple outside, scheming inside' + -스럽다 'having that quality'.

형상.ex: 구름이 마치 용의 형상을 하고 있어요.
형상.x: The cloud is shaped just like a dragon.
형상.t: 형상화하다 means 'to give concrete form to' an idea, common in art and literature.

도파민.x: Eating food you like releases dopamine.
도파민.e: From English 'dopamine.' Also slang: 도파민 중독 for craving quick thrills online.
nb: 미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다
